_readme: Declared renames for the storage-layout guard (#1274 / #2092). A field that kept its slot and its meaning under a new name is declared here ONCE and honoured forever, by CI and by the deploy-time check, because a chain refreshed long after the rename still needs it. Each entry anchors on the field's exact OLD line in the golden file: { region, slot, offset, from, to, reason } for a field (region is the root id, or a nested region such as vaipakam@57[uint256]; from/to are full paths), or { enum, index, from, to, reason } for an enum member. A field given a NEW MEANING is a break, never a rename. See docs/DesignsAndPlans/StorageLayoutGuardDesign.md.

#2910 (owner decision O1 = A: every chain gets a fresh deploy; prelive, no legacy shims): the #1662 recovery-attribution watermark retired receipts created before per-receipt attribution on a Diamond refreshed in place. Receipt ids come from remitReservationNonce, which advances only on canonical-gated surfaces, and a fresh canonical deploy armed at zero before its first receipt, so no receipt on this build predates attribution; the watermark, its arming, the custody-activation pre-check and the Unclassified row's returned figure for pre-attribution receipts are removed. The slot keeps its place and is no longer read or written. Same type and position; marked retired, not repurposed.

#2910 (owner decision O1 = A: every chain gets a fresh deploy; prelive, no legacy shims): the #2489 reservation history rule stamped released reservations' stranded records and booked consumed reservations' recycled shares for records written before those fields existed on a Diamond upgraded in place. On a fresh deploy a release writes its stranded record in the same transaction that sets status 3, and every attested consumption books its share in the transaction that stamps it, so the rule, its permissionless walk, the history figure and the lens views are removed. The field keeps its place and is no longer read or written. Same type and position; marked retired, not repurposed.

#2910 (owner decision O1 = A: every chain gets a fresh deploy; prelive, no legacy shims): the paid-side seed (#1434 P1-b) and the slice-4 paid-side rebase imported a reconstructed paid total on a Diamond upgraded in place, each behind a one-shot guard. A fresh deploy has no paid history to import (its paid and received sides start at zero), so DeployDiamond only ever consumed both guards with zero; the two writers, their guards, their getters, the activation's and the bootstrap writers' rebase prerequisite and the refresh's bootstrap mode are removed. The slot keeps its place and is no longer read or written. Same type and position; marked retired, not repurposed.

#2910 (owner decision O1 = A: every chain gets a fresh deploy; prelive, no legacy shims): the bootstrap envelope import (#1566 closure 2 cutover PR 2) classified inventory that reached a Diamond upgraded in place before its packets were stamped. On a fresh deploy that inventory is zero: the budget ingress now refuses a split that does not account for the whole delivery on the pre-activation path as well as the epoch path, so no untyped remainder enters the uncounted aggregate before activation, and every other pre-activation uncounted arrival is a quarantine the stranded-recovery reservation and the returned cumulative already explain. The import, its preview and record getter, its event, errors and recycle helper are removed. The field keeps its place and is no longer read or written. Same type and position; marked retired, not repurposed.

#1980 (owner decision: retire the peg-custody borrower LIF path; every chain gets a fresh deploy, O1 = A): since #1352 the borrower Loan Initiation Fee is charged in the lending asset at acceptance and nothing writes this custody row. Its producer, its settle / forfeit / credit drains, the claim lane that paid its rebate, its view and its NFT-summary fields are removed. The mapping keeps its slot and is no longer read or written. Same type and position; marked retired, not repurposed.
